name: Uptrend pullback buy, RSI + ADX + position (15m)
rationale: A three-way filter for buying dips WITHIN strength on 15m: ADX confirms a trend, range_position above the mid confirms price is still in the upper half of its range (structure intact), and an RSI dip marks a shallow, tactical pullback to enter on. This buys the discount without catching a falling knife — the position filter ensures we are not buying a breakdown. The other side is the short-term profit-taker selling the dip. Edge persists because trend pullbacks are the highest-reward-to-risk entries in a trend. Distinct from the 1h pullback spec by adding the structural range filter and running at 15m. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX collapses under the exit floor, or the stop fires if the pullback becomes a reversal.
catalyst: shallow RSI pullback within an intact up-structure
